dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct pale-gray to white margins provide high-contrast boundaries against the darker gray-brown bodies of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Clear transition where the uniform tan-brown plumage of the crown and hindneck meets the high-contrast scalloped pattern of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent black mask covering the lores and periocular region; exceptionally large, thick, pale-colored bill.
